facts.fact: UNDP states that the Liberia National Police was the first justice institution to roll out the online Case Management Information System, whose data capture module records case information including the parties, the offences, the proceedings and the outcome; it gives no count of stations or officers using it, and no date for the rollout, so the document's published date is used.

UNDP states that case data is captured on a web and mobile application whose mobile app works online and offline with GPS, on a DHIS2 platform, and that once synchronised the system is to serve as a central repository; where the police enter the data is not stated, and the document's published date is used.

UNDP states that the UN Joint Rule of Law Programme supported the conception, design, development and roll-out of the CMIS for the Judiciary, the Ministry of Justice's prosecution department and the Liberia National Police; no domestic funding is mentioned, and the document's published date is used.

systems.country_label: CMIS; JCMIS in a figure caption
systems.platform: DHIS2, open-source web application and a mobile app working online and offline, with data capture, analytics, reporting and administration modules
systems.owner: the Judiciary, the Prosecution Department of the Ministry of Justice and the Liberia National Police, with the UN Joint Rule of Law Programme
systems.tiers: police first to roll out; users named are court data clerks, county attorneys, statisticians and police officers; tiers not stated

systems.system: CMIS as central data repository for the criminal justice system
systems.tiers: stated as what the CMIS will be once synchronised; not stated as done

note: Classed record because the capture module holds case-level information; the document also says officers were trained to gather and report real time case statistics, and the police's research and planning deputy commissioner speaks of crime data collection and statistical reports, so the system may be a statistics one on the police side. The parent should weigh the class.
